android_mechanism: Worker scheduling not adapted to the workload; fix parallelizes/adapts scheduling
bug_description: refreshAllFeeds fetches every due feed strictly sequentially (await per feed inside a for loop). Each fetch waits for the previous feed's full network round-trip and parse, so refreshing many subscriptions takes the SUM of all per-feed latencies instead of overlapping them.
fix_summary: Due feeds are fetched by a bounded worker pool (4 concurrent), overlapping network latency while limiting parallelism.
trigger_steps: Subscribe to 10+ feeds on reachable hosts.
Start hitrace capture (categories: app, sched, network).
Stop hitrace when refresh completes. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: Wall time from refresh start to the last feed's completion, from network activity in the trace.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed total ~= sum of per-feed latencies (serialized request timeline); fixed overlaps up to 4 fetches. With 10+ feeds, fixed refresh time <= ~50% of unfixed.

oracle_revision.reason: The definition is the wall time to refresh all feeds, measured between the OHMB markers. That is exactly what the harness records as elapsed_ms.
oracle_revision.note: Renamed only. The definition, comparison rule and every recorded measurement are unchanged; no number changed meaning.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 60 app sched network -o /data/local/tmp/sr_refresh.chtrace
